items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: unless maybe King Oliver or somebody, uh, back far enough started him and Bunk picked it up.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear him where you, uh, thought he was trying to play a Louis chorus or anything?

Well, he had choruses that, that I wondered where it came from. Uh, St. Louis blues, when his lip was, was strong at the Stuyvesant, he'd get up and play the, the four or five successive choruses that I had heard Louis play on St. Louis blues. Uh-huh. And, uh, it sure sounded when he played him like he had invented him. I mean, it didn't sound like he was imitating anybody younger than himself, you know, uh, but, uh, of course it's impossible to tell where it started. Yeah. I, I tend to feel that, uh, because…
Yeah, we'll never know now, I guess, actually, what happened.
